summaryDeep:
This person helps you get to the point.

They can help you put your thoughts into words, make decisions, and move conversations forward when you've been going in circles. Talking to them often feels productive. Ideas turn into plans. Questions get clearer. Problems feel easier to tackle.

The potential is there, but it usually takes some effort from both people. The more willing you are to talk things through, be honest, and stay engaged, the easier it is to understand each other and make progress together.

The challenge is not settling for what's easy. It can be tempting to stick to familiar topics or avoid conversations that feel a little more vulnerable. But this connection tends to grow when both people are willing to go a bit deeper.

Be direct. The more openly you communicate, the more useful this connection becomes.
